correctness.rationale: For every \(q=2^n\ge8\), the separating variable \(y\) defines an additive Galois extension of degree \(r=q/2\) with exactly one branch point. The explicit local uniformizer \(y^2/x\) proves the different and the canonical divisor. The \(g=r(r-1)\) holomorphic monomial basis is exhaustive. The four-case Cartier action follows from \(L(x)=x+T(x)^2\) and \(dx=y^{2r}dy\). The polynomial injectivity lemma controls cancellations; a complete parity count gives \(\operatorname{rank}(\mathcal C^2)=9r^2/16-5r/4\) without extrapolation. Exact binary checks with the included code give second ranks \(4,26,124,536\) at \(q=8,16,32,64\). No claim is made about every higher iterate.

originality.rationale: The Higashine 2026 primary source treats Galois lines, not Cartier. Nourozi–Tafazolian–Rahmati (2021) explicitly proves the first-rank/a-number \(q^2/16\) of this very curve; the second-iterate rank is absent from the inspected eight-page research article and cannot be deduced from genus, first rank, or supersingularity. The strongest searched related higher-iterate theorem, Almeida Filho–Tafazolian–Vieira (2026), assumes an odd prime and concerns \(y^p-y=xR(x)\), not this characteristic-two Kummer-over-additive extension. Exact searchable-result and earlier-result comparisons return related but noncovering items. No priority certification is claimed; the Nourozi 2021 doctoral thesis could not be fully inspected.
residual_risks: An inaccessible or unindexed equivalent second Cartier rank calculation may exist, particularly within V. Nourozi (2021), The Rank Cartier Operator and Linear System on Curves (doctoral dissertation).
A stronger quotient functoriality result might implicitly specialize to this characteristic-two maximal curve; no direct implication has been identified in inspected primary material.
Same-model validation is not independent mathematical review.

value.rationale: The source curve is the natural even-characteristic maximal genus runner-up. Its a-number and first Cartier rank were already determined, whereas the second Cartier rank is a meaningful next invariant of the p-torsion/Cartier filtration. The infinite closed formula refines the known coarse data (genus, supersingularity, first rank) and reveals nontrivial systematic second-step behavior in unbounded genus. It is not a reparametrization, special case or isolated finite enumeration.
